messages.subject: Running Sobol sensity analysis for SWATplus
parts:
Hi,

i am trying to run a sobol sensitivity analysis on a Linux system. I am unable to upload an observed dataset on the interface, getting this error when i try to locate the file: Warning: Unknown or uninitialised column: `path`.

So i am trying to use the version without an interface. The equations below do not work. I cannot find convertRange either in the R-SWAT github or on my downloaded drive. I am also unsure how to apply this to SWATplus (i am unsure where to find the SWAT function).

samplingApproach <- "Sensi_(from_userDefined_package)"
# 8. Additional information about parameter calibratoin sensitivity analysis

# Generate parameter samples using User defined method (Sobol)
sensCaliObject <- SWAT(convertRange(sobol_matrices(N =nrow(paraSelection), params = paste("X", 1:nParam, sep = "")), minCol, maxCol))
sobol_indices(Y = sensCaliObject, N = nrow(paraSelection), params = paste("X", 1:nParam, sep = ""))$results

Thank you
Aimen
